### The Greatest Thing You Can Do with Your Life
Author: Jon Bloom
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/the-greatest-thing-you-can-do-with-your-life
Passage: 1 Corinthians 7:17
Points:
- Every person's current life situation is an intentional assignment given by God.
- Calling encompasses your whole life of love and obedience, not just an esteemed career.
- Obsessing over future possibilities can distract you from fulfilling today's calling.
- Difficult or painful circumstances do not disqualify you from serving God faithfully right now.

### Letting Go of Unrealistic Expectations and Embracing What Is
Author: Amanda Idleman
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/ibelieve-truth-a-devotional-for-women/letting-go-of-unrealistic-expectations-and-embracing-what-is.html
Passage: 1 Corinthians 7:17
Points:
- Everyday callings often look messy rather than matching our idealized expectations.
- Grieving unmet dreams creates space to embrace God's grace in the present moment.
- Holy contentment means accepting your current situation rather than constantly longing for more.
- God does not call believers to earthly greatness, but to persistent faithfulness where they are.
